title: A note laundered through memory stays marked and cannot be pinned
what: One agent saves a note from a web page and says so. A second agent reads it, then writes a clean-looking summary of it in its own words and tries to pin the summary. The summary must inherit the mark (written after reading unconfirmed memory), the pin must be refused, and neither text may reach session start.

expect.desc: the declared note is still searchable (labelled, not hidden)
the summary is marked: its writer had just read unconfirmed outside content
pinning the laundered summary is refused until a person confirms it
neither note's text reaches session start while unconfirmed
